title.value: The South African National Orchid Show
title.note: AMENDED 2026-08-12 by team-lead ruling (contract-show-visitor-info A61). Originally migrated verbatim from the ShowBand.tsx headline as 'The 19th South African National Orchid Show'. The ordinal came out: the edition is `nationalShow.edition`'s fact, and duplicating it in the title meant changing the edition in Studio left a stale '19th' in the H1 — the exact class of failure the show-identity work exists to eliminate. The ordinal still renders everywhere it should, derived from `edition`. This amends the seeded STRING only; the 'TITLE — WIRE AS-IS' ruling at contracts/cms-loop-f3-national-show.yaml:121 (render the CMS title verbatim, do not restructure the H1) stands unchanged.

showDate.note: GAP. ShowBand.tsx's SHOW_META only has a display string 'September 2027' ('Dates' row), which is not a parseable ISO datetime — inventing a specific day/time would be fabricating content, not migrating it. Left unset.

location.note: JUDGMENT CALL, recorded not papered over: ShowBand.tsx's SHOW_META has TWO separate location-ish strings — 'Host Region': 'Western Cape' and 'Venue': 'Cape Town International Convention Centre' — but the schema has only one 'location' field. Migrated the Venue string (the more specific physical location) verbatim. The Host Region value 'Western Cape' has no corresponding schema field and is NOT migrated anywhere — GAP, flag for @docs/Brad if a host-region field is wanted.

hero.note: Migrated by uploading public/images/orchid-yellow.jpg as a Sanity image asset — the exact file ShowBand.tsx renders as its background image ('Yellow orchid on the show bench').

countdownDate.note: Migrated verbatim from ShowBand.tsx's DEFAULT_COUNTDOWN_DATE constant.

exhibitorStages.note: GAP. No hardcoded exhibitor-stage copy exists anywhere in the codebase to migrate from. Also note per OVERNIGHT-PLAN and docs/f6-page-singletons.md: full, current nationalShow content is time-sensitive and owned by Brad/the National Show committee, tied to the still-open National Show brand-architecture question — this seed only migrates what is genuinely already hardcoded, it does not attempt to supply real show content.
